description: Infrastructure + Backend OCR Module: Thêm ocr-service vào docker-compose, route nginx, RestTemplate bean, Flyway migration V30, và toàn bộ module ocr trong backend (entity Receipt, DTOs, ReceiptRepository, OcrService proxy tới AI, OcrController).
steps: STEP 1 — docker-compose.yml: Thêm service `ocr-service` sau service `redis`. Build từ `./ai/ocr-service`, container_name: ocr-service, expose: 8000, networks: finance_network, restart: unless-stopped, volumes: ocr_models:/app/models. Thêm volume `ocr_models:` vào top-level volumes. Thêm env var `OCR_SERVICE_URL=http://ocr-service:8000` vào environment của service `backend`. Thêm `depends_on: ocr-service: condition: service_started` vào service `backend`.

STEP 2 — nginx/nginx.conf: Thêm upstream `upstream ocr_service { server ocr-service:8000; keepalive 16; }`. Thêm location block `/ai/` proxy tới `http://ocr_service/` với timeout 120s (OCR xử lý lâu hơn). Tăng `client_max_body_size` từ 10M lên 15M.

STEP 4 — backend/src/main/resources/application.yml: Tăng `spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size` và `max-request-size` từ `5MB` lên `15MB`. Thêm vào section `app:` key `ai: ocr-service-url: ${OCR_SERVICE_URL:http://ocr-service:8000}`.

STEP 5 — WebConfig.java (e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/common/config/WebConfig.java): Thêm import `org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate` và `org.springframework.boot.web.client.RestTemplateBuilder`. Thêm `@Bean public RestTemplate restTemplate(RestTemplateBuilder builder) { return builder.connectTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(10)).readTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(120)).build(); }`.

STEP 6 — V30__create_receipts_table.sql tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V30__create_receipts_table.sql: CREATE TABLE core.receipts với các cột: id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES core.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, image_url TEXT, kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', merchant_name VARCHAR(500), transaction_date DATE, transaction_time TIME, total_amount BIGINT, currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VND', raw_text TEXT, confidence DECIMAL(3,2), needs_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, ai_category_id VARCHAR(100), ai_category_name VARCHAR(200), ai_category_confidence DECIMAL(3,2), ai_category_source VARCHAR(50), transaction_id UUID REFERENCES core.transactions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(). Thêm indexes: idx_receipts_user_id ON core.receipts(user_id), idx_receipts_created_at ON core.receipts(created_at DESC).

STEP 7 — Receipt.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/entity/Receipt.java: @Entity @Table(name='receipts', schema='core') với tất cả fields map 1-1 với SQL migration. Dùng @GeneratedValue(strategy=GenerationType.UUID), @CreationTimestamp, @UpdateTimestamp như Transaction.java.

STEP 8 — OcrReceiptResponse.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/dto/OcrReceiptResponse.java: @Data @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor. Fields: UUID id, String kind, String merchantName, LocalDate transactionDate, LocalTime transactionTime, Long totalAmount, String currency, Double confidence, Boolean needsReview, String aiCategoryId, String aiCategoryName, Double aiCategoryConfidence, String imageUrl, UUID transactionId.

STEP 9 — CreateTransactionFromOcrRequest.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/dto/CreateTransactionFromOcrRequest.java: @Data @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor. Fields: @NotNull UUID receiptId, @NotNull UUID accountId, UUID categoryId, String description, String note.

STEP 10 — ReceiptRepository.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/repository/ReceiptRepository.java: extend JpaRepository<Receipt, UUID>. Methods: Optional<Receipt> findByIdAndUserId(UUID id, UUID userId), Page<Receipt> findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(UUID userId, Pageable pageable).

STEP 11 — OcrService.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/service/OcrService.java: @Service @RequiredArgsConstructor @Slf4j. Inject RestTemplate restTemplate, ReceiptRepository receiptRepository, TransactionService transactionService, AccountRepository accountRepository, CategoryRepository categoryRepository. @Value('${app.ai.ocr-service-url}') String aiServiceUrl. Methods: (a) OcrReceiptResponse scanReceipt(UUID userId, MultipartFile file) — validate file type (image/jpeg, image/png) và size (≤10MB), build MultiValueMap với FileSystemResource từ file.getBytes(), POST tới aiServiceUrl+'/ocr/receipt' với user_id param, parse response vào ReceiptResult POJO, lưu Receipt entity, return OcrReceiptResponse. (b) TransactionResponse createTransactionFromOcr(UUID userId, CreateTransactionFromOcrRequest req) — load Receipt by id+userId (404 nếu không tìm thấy), build CreateTransactionRequest với type=EXPENSE, amount từ receipt.totalAmount, date từ receipt.transactionDate (fallback NOW), categoryId từ req.categoryId ?? receipt.aiCategoryId, note req.note, call transactionService.createTransaction(userId, txReq), update receipt.transactionId, save, return. (c) Page<OcrReceiptResponse> getReceipts(UUID userId, Pageable pageable). (d) void deleteReceipt(UUID userId, UUID receiptId). Inner POJO class AiReceiptResult để deserialize AI response (Jackson @JsonProperty mapping snake_case fields).

STEP 12 — OcrController.java tại e:/Desktop/DATN-fake/DATN-fake/backend/src/main/java/com/finance/finance/modules/ocr/controller/OcrController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/v1/ocr') @RequiredArgsConstructor @Slf4j. Endpoints: POST /receipts (consumes multipart/form-data, @RequestPart('image') MultipartFile image), POST /receipts/{id}/create-transaction (@RequestBody @Valid CreateTransactionFromOcrRequest), GET /receipts (params page=1, pageSize=20), DELETE /receipts/{id}. Pattern y hệt TransactionController — dùng @AuthenticationPrincipal User user, return ResponseEntity<>.
